name: VehicleActuatorEnvironment
description: Environment actuator and sensor MCP server for vehicle driving simulation.

skills.name: execute_vehicle_action
skills.description: Executes a driving control action on the vehicle actuator in the environment.

speed_delta.description: Amount of speed change in km/h (optional, default 20 km/h).

right_lane_free.description: Sensor reading indicating whether the right lane is free.

skills.name: get_vehicle_telemetry
skills.description: Returns the current vehicle telemetry and sensory status.
